names.note: Name page 13753 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Николай (Удинцев), иерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Николая пресвитера». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE and a Cyrillic grep for «Удинцев» over every `saint.json` returns nothing — the bare «Николай» was out of the question, the corpus holding a great many.

death.note: The day line closes «(1918)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 25 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Николая пресвитера (1918).»

attestations.note: The day's fifth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line says «пресвитера» and name page 13753 «иерей», priest, which agree, so `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are both the source's own words. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*udintsev*` is empty and the Cyrillic grep returns nothing. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
